xna-type.name: XmlImporter
xna-type.summary: Implements an importer for reading intermediate XML files. This is a wrapper around IntermediateSerializer.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of XmlImporter.

method.name: Import
method.summary: Called by the framework when importing an intermediate file containing a game asset.

overload.summary: Called by the framework when importing an intermediate file containing a game asset.

parameters.parameter: Contains information for importing the intermediate file, such as a logger interface.

overload.returns: Object representing the game asset contained by the intermediate file.
